title: Reviews
description: Send customers an automatic review request after delivery, follow up on low scores and send happy customers to Google.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view reviews.
empty_hint: Turn on review collection in the settings; requests go out automatically for delivered jobs.
follow_up.title: Mark as handled
follow_up.description: If you reached out to the customer, add a short note on what was done.
follow_up.note_placeholder: E.g. Called the customer, washed the car again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE: No WhatsApp or SMS channel is connected. Connect one in the messaging settings first.
errors.CONFLICT: This action is not possible right now.
errors.FEATURE_DISABLED: Review collection is not included in your plan.
summary.follow_up_hint: Low scores, show in the list
summary.trend_weekly: Weekly requests, answers and average score
summary.trend_monthly: Monthly requests, answers and average score
detail.title: Review
detail.follow_up_hint: The customer gave a low score. Call them, solve the issue and mark it as handled.
detail.deferred: Moved to the morning because of quiet hours
detail.waiting.scheduled: The request is scheduled and goes out after the delay and quiet hours.
detail.waiting.sent: The request was sent; waiting for the customer.
detail.waiting.opened: The customer opened the page but has not rated yet.
detail.waiting.expired: The link expired without an answer.
detail.waiting.cancelled: The request was cancelled before sending.
detail.waiting.skipped: The request was not sent because of the rules.
detail.waiting.failed: The message could not be sent.
customer.empty: No review requests for this customer.
customer.empty_hint: Requests are created automatically after delivered jobs.
settings.title: Review settings
settings.description: Choose when, on which channel and with which text reviews are requested.
settings.enabled_hint: When on, every delivered job sends the customer a review request.
settings.channel_missing: The selected channel cannot send right now.
settings.delay_hint: The request goes out this long after the vehicle is delivered.
settings.quiet_hours_hint: No messages between these hours; requests move to the morning (Istanbul time).
settings.threshold_hint: Scores at or above the threshold are sent to Google; lower scores need a follow-up and notify the team.
settings.google_invalid: Enter a valid link starting with https://.
settings.google_help_title: How do I get the link?
settings.google_help_1: Sign in to your Google Business Profile (business.google.com) or search for your business on Google.
settings.google_help_3: Copy the link shown (it starts with g.page/r/…) and paste it here.
settings.consent_placeholder: E.g. I allow the business to share my review for promotional purposes.
settings.consent_hint: When set, it is shown as a checkbox on the page.
settings.excluded_hint: These customers never get a review request.
settings.read_only: Only the business owner can change these settings.
settings.template_vars: Variables: {musteri_adi}, {isletme_adi}, {link}. Edit it under Messaging → Templates as "Review request".
settings.test_hint: Send a sample request to your own phone. Leave empty to use the notification phone of your profile.
public.question: How would you rate the service of {{business}}?
public.error: Could not send. Please try again.
public.thanks_google: Glad you were happy. Would you leave a short review for {{business}} on Google?
public.thanks_low: We received your feedback. The business will get in touch with you shortly.
public.expired_hint: This review link is no longer valid.
public.not_found_hint: The link may be wrong or removed.
